cohort: 5460 pregnant women beyond 20 weeks of gestation
finding: In a study of 5460 pregnant women, several factors were found to be associated with HDP-related mortality and morbidity, including severity of HDP, high blood pressure, and proteinuria, while no association was found with age, parity, booking status, socio-economic status, gestational age, or mode of delivery.
mod_finding: While the study found no direct association between mode of delivery and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) related mortality, it acknowledges that all mothers with HDP received antihypertensives and there was a significant burden of maternal and perinatal morbidity, particularly in those with severe preeclampsia and eclampsia, conditions which may necessitate cesarean delivery.
